result.description: Portable storage dock for creators and field technicians who need a rugged, high-capacity transfer station rather than an internal drive. AURORA TIDE pairs a USB-C 10 Gbps bridge with an NVMe 4.0 enclosure, supporting quick backup, media offload, and project shuttling between laptops and workstations. The aluminum shell includes thermal pads for passive cooling, a status LED, and tool-free access to the M.2 bay. Designed for 2280 drives up to 8 TB, it emphasizes convenience, compatibility, and quiet operation over maximum benchmark performance.
result.title: AURORA TIDE 2TB NVMe 4.0 External Dock
